Meta.title: LumiClaw Presence | Campaign walking skeleton
Meta.description: Plan, review, and improve market-specific content from one clear objective.

Shell.journeyLabel: Five steps from objective to improvement
Shell.footer: This is a safe preview: no real account is connected and nothing can be approved or published.

campaigns.title: Start with one clear campaign objective.
campaigns.summary: This is where you will explain what you are promoting, who it is for, and what you want people to do. Content and review will stay anchored to that objective.
campaigns.status: You can create, save, and reopen a demo campaign
campaigns.basis: Data is stored in local PostgreSQL; everything remains public-safe demo seed with no real account.
campaigns.next: Set the objective and call to action, then create the first demo campaign.
campaigns.previewTitle: When ready, this area will summarize

previewItems.first: The outcome you want this campaign to achieve
previewItems.third: The next item that needs your attention

campaigns.technicalBasis: REST, OpenAPI, Idempotency-Key, ETag, and version snapshots share one PostgreSQL control plane.

setup.title: Get the facts ready before writing content.
setup.summary: Your brand story, product value, target market, and supporting proof will live together here so every platform starts from the same truth.
setup.status: The minimal brand, product, market, and evidence matrix can be saved
setup.basis: Only synthetic material is used; draft facts remain visibly owner-blocked instead of being treated as approved.
setup.next: Review the brand matrix and supporting evidence while keeping the demo public-safe.

previewItems.second: Facts and proof that may be used publicly

setup.technicalBasis: Organization, Identity, Brand, Product, Market, ChannelAccount, AccountMandate, and Claim–Evidence now enforce tenant scope.

mission.title: Give every task an owner and every conclusion evidence.
mission.summary: Six specialists separately verify facts, plan, write for four platforms, and independently check the work. The coordinator assigns work but produces none of it.
mission.status: All progress, content versions, and checks come from one durable source
mission.basis: This is a safe rehearsal only. Demo results and real collaboration evidence are labeled separately and never imply publication.
mission.next: Start a safe rehearsal from the exact saved version and inspect six responsibilities and dependencies.
mission.previewTitle: Four platform-specific content versions will appear here

previewItems.first: A suitable expression for each platform
previewItems.second: Content you can edit before review
previewItems.third: A preview before handoff or publication

mission.technicalBasis: Project/DAG/ACK/Submit, RoleContext, SkillLock, digest/schema validation, timeout/recovery, and PostgreSQL state have repeatable engineering verification.

review.title: See why one claim was denied, then review the exact correction.
review.summary: An independent checker compares every version with confirmed facts, supporting proof, account responsibility, and platform limits. A correction automatically invalidates the old check.
review.status: The faulty statement was denied; four corrected platform versions need your exact confirmation
review.basis: Your confirmation is explicitly non-executable: it connects no account, triggers no schedule, and performs no external action.
review.next: Compare at most two versions, inspect cited proof and the next responsible person, then confirm the exact version.
review.previewTitle: A real review will bring together

previewItems.first: The exact content proposed for sharing
previewItems.second: The facts that support each statement
previewItems.third: Risk notes and decisions that need you

review.technicalBasis: Immutable four-platform Revisions, FAIL→correction→re-audit, Audit invalidation, and non-executable Owner Review share one control plane. M3 execution remains unimplemented.

learn.title: See what people actually did, then decide what to change.
learn.summary: Comments, interactions, and outcomes will be organized into traceable feedback and suggestions. The system will never rewrite your approved brand facts on its own.
learn.status: Explicitly blocked: there is no real platform feedback
learn.basis: No platform account is connected and no customer, comment, or interaction data has been imported.
learn.next: Confirm that real feedback, system suggestions, and your final decision are clearly separated.
learn.previewTitle: When ready, this area will organize
learn.technicalBasis: Interaction, Outcome, Disposition, and LearningProposal are not implemented or persisted.

Mission.disclaimer: This is an illustration; you will still confirm before anything is shared.

Production.desktopBody: The production workspace currently supports widths of 1024px and above. Mobile operations are deliberately excluded so review and publishing controls are not compressed into an unsafe interface.
Production.errorTitle: The local control plane is unavailable
Production.firstOpenEyebrow: LOCAL FIRST OPEN · this device only
Production.firstOpenTitle: First, tell us what to call you.
Production.firstOpenBody: Only a local display name is needed. There is no email, password, or remote registration, and the browser never collects a model API key.
Production.noExternalActions: First-time setup performs no external publishing
Production.localIntroTitle: A governed public presence starts locally.
Production.localIntroBody: Identity, material, context, review, and every handoff remain visible and recoverable.
Production.displayNameHint: Stored in local PostgreSQL and visible later in Settings.
Production.choiceTitle: Explore with an example, or bring real local material.
Production.choiceBody: Both paths enter the same Organization / Campaign source of truth, with material provenance kept explicit.
Production.exampleBody: Load a LumiClaw example organization, product, four-platform content, and metrics. No external account is connected.
Production.localBody: MD/TXT is parsed server-side, digest-verified, and saved locally. The content never becomes public evidence.
Production.materialBody: UTF-8 .md and .txt files are currently supported, up to 2 MiB each.
Production.materialPlanned: PDF, DOCX: PLANNED · parser, license, and security review incomplete
Production.contextBody: Market, content locale, platform, and time zone are stored separately and never inferred from UI language.
Production.identityTitle: Confirm your Organization, Brand, Product, and Campaign
Production.identityBody: The product does not guess company truth from a file. Compare the extracted text above and confirm these structured fields; saving creates your own LOCAL_PRIVATE Campaign.
Production.productDescriptionPlaceholder: A product description confirmed from the material
Production.campaignObjectivePlaceholder: What the target audience should understand
Production.callToActionPlaceholder: The next step readers should take
Production.finishSetup: Create my Campaign and enter workspace
Production.todayBody: Every task from facts to manual publishing identifies its source, owner, and blocking reason.
Production.campaignBody: One Campaign brings together the objective, market, platform expression, review, schedule, and handoff state.
Production.teamTitle: Six AI team members with stable responsibilities
Production.teamBody: Task surfaces show only the active worker; inspect the complete roster, Skills, token usage, daily work, and errors here.
Production.calendarBody: Only persistent PostgreSQL schedules appear here; no occurrence means no implied execution.
Production.publishBody: Copy text, download media, and open an official publishing page. Owner-reported completion still requires external reconciliation evidence.
Production.feedbackBody: Without official read-back or owner-imported evidence, the product makes no interaction, growth, lead, or revenue conclusions.
Production.knowledgeBody: Inspect the digest, extraction state, and source for public-safe example or local private material.
Production.accountsBody: OAuth, live connectors, and read-back are absent; unavailable capabilities stay disabled with remediation.
Production.settingsBody: Inspect local identity, four context fields, and the safe readiness contract for every service.
Production.auditTask: Independent audit is waiting for the SDD-007 runtime boundary
Production.activeResponsibilityBody: The active responsibility is visible, but no runtime turn is claimed. The global roster contains {count} stable members.
Production.calendarEmptyBody: A later scheduling flow creates and reviews exact occurrence state; host cron and invented calendar events are not used here.
Production.exampleFixtureBody: This workspace uses the built-in public-safe Organization and Campaign fixture.
Production.localMaterialBody: These local materials belong only to this LOCAL_PRIVATE workspace and do not become public evidence.
Production.campaignUnavailableBody: Return to local onboarding or restore project-scoped PostgreSQL. The UI never substitutes in-memory success for the real control plane.
Production.auditResponsibilityBody: There is no AgentTeams runtime observation. This shows the independent-audit responsibility boundary, not a fabricated running state.
Production.reviewBlockedBody: The independent-audit runtime is not configured. Revisions can be inspected in full, but approval stays blocked until an auditable Mission exists.
Production.approvalBlocked: Approval blocked: no independent runtime audit receipt.
Production.artifactSourceRole: Artifact source role · runtime status NOT_CONFIGURED
Production.traceEvidenceBody: The contract exists; there is no current runtime observation.
Production.traceAuditBody: Blocked until the AgentTeams runtime is configured and returns an exact audit receipt.
Production.manualOnlyLabel: Not a business result · manual handoff only
Production.officialDestination: Official destination: {url} · verify the signed-in account yourself.
Production.manualStep1: Copy the exact body or download the current media.
Production.manualStep3: Verify the active account and complete content.
Production.manualStep4: Complete it manually; reconciliation remains pending.
Production.awaitingBody: Opening a page or self-reporting completion is not publication evidence; the state waits for reconciliation while read-back is absent.
Production.teamOverviewBody: Six responsibilities and their Skills are configured. Persistent runtime is absent, so every operating metric remains unobserved.
Production.teamMetricNote: 0 means there is no authoritative runtime observation, not zero business work.
Production.skillAvailabilityBody: This lists repository-owned Skills and static role bindings only; Skill availability is not presented as a running Agent.
Production.noScheduledTasks: There are no persistent scheduled tasks
Production.noScheduledTasksBody: SDD-007 has not provided mission-worker dispatch or persistent AgentTeams runtime. This view creates neither fake tasks nor in-memory timers.

A0.name: Mission coordination
A0.responsibility: Orchestrates tasks and dependencies without producing domain artifacts.

A1.name: Evidence stewardship
A1.responsibility: Freezes approved Claim and Evidence bindings.

A2.name: Market planning
A2.responsibility: Allocates market, account, and platform activation units.

A3.name: Founder content
A3.responsibility: Produces platform content only for the founder identity.

A4.name: Product content
A4.responsibility: Produces platform content only for product accounts.

A5.name: Independent audit
A5.responsibility: Independently checks evidence, permissions, and platform constraints.

Production.oauthNote: OAuth, live probes, automated publishing, and read-back belong to later SDDs; this UI never fabricates success.
Production.readinessReasonSdd007: Complete the later SDD-007 terminal broker and pinned runtime setup.
Production.readinessReasonUnavailable: Start the project-scoped PostgreSQL and migration services.
Production.readinessReasonAvailable: The local probe reached this safe boundary.
Production.secretNote: The browser never receives or stores a model API key. AgentTeams runtime installation and the secret broker belong to SDD-007.
Production.noSchedule: This Campaign has no persistent schedule.
